description: The widget-layer PII path comes back: CARRIER_PII_CEILING and PII_RANK are restored into an authority module, the shape P-K4K8 removed. F95 item 2 (C11:1882-1886) forbids a widget-layer module implementing PII masking of its own, so K4K8-1 must go red, and ARCH-12-2 with it once U12a has merged.

The fourth presentation mode comes back: a PresentationMode declaration inside the widget layer regains 'system', which F18's three modes (C11:292-296, C.5 correction C11:7333) exclude. K4K8-2 must go red.
replace:
export type PresentationMode = 'client' | 'staff' | 'owner' | 'system';

const CLIENT_ROLES = new Set(['client', 'customer']);

description: The ratchet is blinded instead of the path restored: the scan stops at the top level of src/widgets, so a PII path in any subdirectory is no longer seen and K4K8-1 and K4K8-2 pass vacuously. The guard's own scan-coverage case must go red, before and after IR-K4K8-1 alike.
